payload.message:
You are the DAY-shift conductor for quilt-gpu-lab (Casey is active; do NOT message him - book everything in files). READ FIRST: /home/eileen/projects/quilt-gpu-lab/proposals/night-spool-2026-09-30.md (queue + protocol) and the last 40 lines of RESULTS.md. Then execute ONE ~20-minute timeboxed slice, rotating in this order:
(A) SUPERINSTANCE SCOUT (Casey's standing directive): sweep what other agents are PUSHING at the SuperInstance org - recent commits to main (last 48h), open PRs, new issues, [EMBASSY] items - via gh CLI (read-only, no comments/PRs filed). Classify each notable push as STEAL / CORROBORATE / CONTRADICT / TOOL against our live assets (QO2 routing stack = QO1 oracle + QG3/QG6 triage + QO6 eproc; DECIDE-1 post-mortem and DECIDE-2; receipt-manifest doctrine; QG3+QG6 time-law; QG1c swap-convention census; edge-mine seeds W5a/W5b/W5c). CONTRADICT findings are the highest value - name what booked result they threaten. Spawn 1-3 concrete queue items: question, pre-registered gates in words, cost estimate.
(B) TOP OPEN QUEUE ITEM (pre-register in proposals/runs/ and commit+push BEFORE firing; run with /home/eileen/venvs/elephant-gpu/bin/python; book honestly in RESULTS.md with a QUEUE mark).
(C) BOOKKEEPING: verify the most recent booking's COMMITTED script reproduces its COMMITTED result (re-run it - three dirty-tree booking instances found 2026-09-30, so this is now mandatory); re-seal receipts/manifest.json (python tools/receipt_manifest.py - it refuses to seal dirty sealed paths) after any ledger change; mark spool statuses so no wake repeats work.
DISCIPLINE: never duplicate an IN-PROGRESS item (check git log + running processes first); archive-never-delete; keys never echoed; NO retry loops on 429 - if rate-limited, book partial findings and STOP; fail-loud anchors; commit+push every landing. GPU: RTX 4050 6GB, one lane at a time (serial). Append your slice to the spool with status marks.

TOOLS LANE (wheel spoke). Working dir: /home/eileen/projects/quilt-gpu-lab. Mission: build ONE new grabbable standalone tool tonight and land it in tools/ with a catalog entry.

1. Read tools/README.md (the catalog) - see what exists, pick an open slot. Good candidates extracted from tonight's proven work: (a) typesafe-batch - standalone CLI wrapping the batched rule-rich judge pattern from experiments/cm1_relay_r4.py/r5.py (tsafe_batch: state+questions JSON -> answers, retry-once, jev-latest/jev-preview flag); (b) checkpoint-guard - the embedding-checkpoint save/verify/resume pattern from experiments/c5_paired_action.py as a reusable python module; (c) farm-queue-flip - safe queue.json entry flipper with JSON validation + prereg-commit check.
2. Write the tool as a single self-contained file (python, stdlib-only where possible), with --help, fail-loud errors, and a worked example in its docstring.
3. TEST it for real (run the example path; for typesafe-batch use a 2-question smoke against the real API - token at ~/.config/typesafe/token, endpoint https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone).
4. Add a catalog entry to tools/README.md (name, one-liner, usage line).
5. git add, commit 'tool: <name> - <one-liner>', push origin main.

RULES: one tool per run, small and finished beats big and partial. List-form subprocess only. Never delete; archive-by-rename. Keys never echoed. REPORT: tool name, path, test receipt, commit hash - compact.
